newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 21.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - West African nations to set up joint body to monitor fight against cross-border crime wave; plan to share resources and set up data bank - National assembly to debate draft law on composition and functions of supreme court on March 25 LA VOIE - Opposition Ivorian Patriotic Front leader Laurent Gbagbo tells people in his western Ouragahio constituency -- in a region which saw bloody ethnic clashes before the 1995 presidential election -- to shun violence LE JOUR - Finance ministry workers angry over pay; threaten strike on March 24 and 25
